name: INGV Earthquakes
description: Search the INGV earthquake catalogue (Italy) and show the events on the map.
author: onData

screenshots.caption: The earthquakes of the last 24 hours north of Sicily, magnitude 2 and above, coloured by depth and sized by magnitude.
The results table, sorted by magnitude: the event under the pointer is ringed on the map.
An event's detail: summary, felt reports, how location and magnitude changed after the first estimate, seismicity around.
